# UsableNet Blog

> > UsableNet's blog provides comprehensive guidance on digital accessibility compliance, remediation strategies, and best practices for ADA and WCAG standards across industries.

UsableNet is a leading digital accessibility platform offering insights on WCAG 2.1/2.2 compliance, ADA litigation trends, and practical accessibility solutions for ecommerce, healthcare, and retail sectors. The blog features expert analysis from defense counsel perspectives and real-world accessibility barriers affecting users with disabilities.

## Key Topics

- ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act)
- WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines)
- WCAG 2.1 & WCAG 2.2
- Web Accessibility Compliance
- Ecommerce Accessibility
- Accessibility Testing & Audits
- Screen Reader Compatibility
- ADA Lawsuits & Litigation
- Healthcare Accessibility
- Retail & Digital UX
- EN 301 549 Standards
- Section 504 Compliance
- JAWS Screen Reader
- European Accessibility Act

## Ecommerce Accessibility Guides

- [Ecommerce Website Accessibility Guide: ADA, WCAG & Best Practices](https://blog.usablenet.com/ecommerce-website-accessibility-guide): Comprehensive ecommerce accessibility guide covering ADA, WCAG 2.1, best practices
- [Ecommerce Accessibility Checklist: How to Make Your Online Store ADA & WCAG Compliant](https://blog.usablenet.com/ecommerce-accessibility-checklist-how-to-make-your-online-store-ada-wcag-compliant): Comprehensive checklist for ADA and WCAG 2.1 AA ecommerce compliance
- [Common Ecommerce Website Accessibility Issues (and How to Fix Them)](https://blog.usablenet.com/common-ecommerce-website-accessibility-issues-and-how-to-fix-them): Common ecommerce accessibility issues with WCAG 2.2 fixes and best practices
- [Why Blind Shoppers Can't Complete Online Checkout](https://blog.usablenet.com/shopping-cart-accessibility-screen-reader-barriers): Screen reader barriers in shopping carts and WCAG checkout compliance
- [Why Blind Shoppers Struggle With Online Product Returns](https://blog.usablenet.com/online-product-return-accessibility-barriers): Accessibility barriers in online returns: QR codes and form limitations
